# AngelsForMen

> AngelsForMen (https://www.angelsformen.com) is Uttarakhand's premier independent companion classified directory and verified advertising network, connecting discerning adult gentlemen with verified independent VIP companions, call girls, luxury models, and sensual wellness massage providers across major tourist, commercial, and urban destinations in Uttarakhand.

## Core Platform Overview

AngelsForMen operates strictly as an independent advertising portal and intermediary service under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act. The platform maintains a zero-tolerance policy against advance fee scams, digital fraud, non-consensual media, and fraudulent listings. All listed companion profiles undergo photo and identity verification prior to listing approval.

The platform strictly enforces a mandatory **"Zero Online Advance Payment" (Cash on Delivery)** policy. Clients must never send digital payments, registration fees, hotel booking charges, medical clearance deposits, or UPI transfers before meeting in person. All financial arrangements are settled strictly between consenting adults in person upon physical verification.

- **Platform URL:** https://www.angelsformen.com/

- **Age Restriction:** Strictly 18+ (Adults Only, Age Verification Enforced)
- **Primary Service Types:** Incall (Companion's Private Residence / Studio) & Outcall (Reputed 4/5-Star Hotels & Luxury Hill Resort Suites)
- **Payment Policy:** 100% Cash on Delivery (Zero Online Advances)
- **Primary Regional Focus:** Uttarakhand, India (Dehradun, Haldwani, Mussoorie, Nainital, Ramnagar / Jim Corbett, Rishikesh)
- **Exhaustive Documentation:** https://www.angelsformen.com/llms-full.txt

## Safety, Verification & Anti-Fraud Standards

1. **Strict Zero Online Advance Policy:** Neither AngelsForMen nor genuine independent companions will ever request digital advances, registration charges, medical clearance deposits, or taxi charges. All payments are made strictly in person via cash on delivery (COD).
2. **Profile & Age Verification:** Advertisers provide genuine photos and valid government identification proving age of majority (strictly 18+).
3. **Discreet Communication:** Direct communication via secure phone calls, WhatsApp, or Telegram. Clients are advised to maintain mutual respect, clear boundaries, and discretion.
4. **Hotel Outcall Best Practices:** When booking outcalls, meet only at verified 4-star, 5-star, or reputable boutique resorts. Avoid secluded or unverified meeting points.
5. **Mutual Consent & Discretion:** Safe practices, personal hygiene, and mutual consent are strictly mandatory for all encounters.
